title: Distribution-Aware Reward Estimation for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical proofs comparing majority-voting expected rewards against marginal ground truth rewards, alongside empirical evaluation using token-level overlap to measure correlation-induced bias in generated rollouts.

Analyzing the degradation of test-time reinforcement learning performance as rollout correlation increases, demonstrating how majority-voting estimators self-reinforce early, suboptimal but frequent responses (confirmation collapse).
